title: Who ran the band: Glaser or Louis
summary: Glaser hired and fired, but Louis named Joe himself, having wanted him since Joe's Ory days.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Some people say that Joe Glaser ran the band and some people say that Louis ran the band.
No, Joe Glaser ran the band, really...
I don't mean the business. I mean inside the band.

As far as hiring and firing guys, you had to do something (I don't know) real bad to get fired out of that band to start with. Because Louis would have the last word. But if somebody wanted to leave the band or whatever, Joe Glaser...it was up to him to hire somebody unless Louis specifically named somebody. In my case, he named me. He told Joe about me, because he had... Years before I talked to Louis, Louis said, 'I'd always like to have you,' even when I was with Kid Ory. He said, 'But I wouldn't break Kid's band up or anything like that. But sometime when I get a spot, I want you to play, I want you to be in my band.'
